description: This file implements netlink-based conntrack management, including listing, creating, updating, deleting, and filtering connection tracking flows for Linux kernel netfilter. It defines data structures, constants, and methods for handling conntrack entries via netlink messages.

classes.name: ConntrackFlow
classes.description: Represents a connection tracking flow with IP tuples, protocol info, and metadata.

classes.name: ProtoInfoTCP
classes.description: Represents TCP protocol-specific info, such as TCP state.

classes.name: IPTuple
classes.description: Represents IP source/destination addresses, ports, protocol, and byte/packet counts.

classes.name: ConntrackFilter
classes.description: Implements filtering criteria for conntrack flows based on IP, ports, labels, zone, and protocol.

methods.name: ConntrackTableList
methods.description: Returns a list of conntrack flows from a specified table and family.

methods.name: ConntrackTableFlush
methods.description: Flushes all flows in a specified conntrack table.

methods.name: ConntrackCreate
methods.description: Creates a new conntrack flow entry.

methods.name: ConntrackUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing conntrack flow entry.

methods.name: ConntrackDeleteFilter
methods.description: Deletes conntrack entries matching a filter.

methods.name: ConntrackDeleteFilters
methods.description: Deletes multiple conntrack entries matching filters.

methods.name: parseRawData
methods.description: Parses raw netlink data into a ConntrackFlow structure.
